probe_b_conditional.protected_diffuse_and_alpha: Still verify every full-render diffuseRGBA and specular/diffusealpha word locally for every paired frame. Return counts/hashes/mismatches; omit identical repeated diffuse payload from this conditional response window.
probe_b_conditional.unavailable_rule: Report unavailable if no independently identified light/colour event or trustworthy motion correspondence exists. Signal change cannot be separated from noise simply by collecting more of the same aligned output.

optional_replica_pilot.condition: Only if the local renderer can actually produce independently seeded matching-pose trajectories with matched history/setup. This capability is not assumed.
optional_replica_pilot.origin_rule: Select and freeze a64x64even-origin subcrop inside the original BASEglass region before examining candidate outcomes; retain full-render coordinates.
optional_replica_pilot.exact_stage_and_format: Each replica/frame: original input_specularRGBA16F, raw_rr_specularRGBA16F, actual pre-Glass selectedRGBA32F;32packedbytes/pixel. Shared original geometry/masks/cameras only once if proven byte-identical; otherwise include within the cap with provenance.
optional_replica_pilot.needed_statistics: Matched S/R covariance for traceCov(S-R), cross-pixel covariance of each2x2correction, temporal correlation/effective support, sparse-tail mass and uncertainty intervals. Expose individual replicas rather than averaging away tails.
optional_replica_pilot.provenance: Independent RNG/trajectory setup, same controlled signal/camera/material/light and equivalent prehistory law; deterministic resets and identical repeated realizations are not independent replicas. Do not claim convergence from16replicas.
optional_replica_pilot.unavailable_rule: If independent replicas or a validated alternative noise model are unattainable, label correction-noise covariance/effective support unobservable, keep t3/t4invalid and abstain. Captured count or luma moment alone is not a substitute.

d3d_debug_and_lifetime_checks: Enable D3D12 debug and GPU-based validation for the small tests; return severity/count/text and any device removal. Zero unexpected errors or warnings is the local gate, not an executed result here.
Verify root signature and reflected t0..t4/u0/b0 formats/counts/32-byte layout; actual CBV upload alignment256 and root/profile compatibility.
All reads immutable and retained through completion; OutPreGlass is a distinct allocation with no input alias. Do not race neighbouring OutColor reads/writes.

Verify SRV/UAV/copy transitions and UAV barriers after every producer; capture reused native scratch at its named boundary before overwrite. Readback transitions must be restored and must not change native outputs.

Validate descriptor heaps, per-frame upload lifetime, recording ownership, cancellation, fences, resource generations and family admission/accounting. Test failed admission/family exhaustion returns untouched baseline and releases only owned resources.
Verify source original geometry/provider prepared geometry/G3 input authority and raw/current alpha ownership. Input alpha/hit distance is never replaced by uncertainty or history count.

Locally compare every diffuse RGBA16F word and every specular/diffuse alpha16 word over the entire actual render extent for every paired frame; return exact word counts, differing counts, hashes and bounded mismatch samples. Do not replace with an all-pixel identity percentage.
Compare original provider input/output and original geometry bytes before/after the new diagnostic; preserve encoded commit contracts, published native pointer ownership and fence lifetimes.
OFF must preserve existing dispatch list, settings words, output pointer/SRV selections, copies and output bytes. Missing/invalid support on ON must abstain at exactly the agreed pre-Glass boundary.

Test odd extents, alternating contexts, frame discontinuity, reset, DRS and unsupported polish/nonreflection paths. Retain the actual preset; unsupported paths abstain rather than being silently disabled.

tolerance_with_rationale.native_off_and_protected_channels: Zero differing words for native no-dispatch OFF, same-frame diffuse RGBA, current output alpha, original input/geometry and forbidden regions.
tolerance_with_rationale.standalone_passthrough: Exact float32 t1 output bytes for finite valid-domain OFF/unsupported/zero-variance/constant-correction cases; preserve signed zero and original alpha. Deliberately malformed optional metadata is a separate native host rejection/copy test, not Python exception parity.

standalone_active_arithmetic.combination: Larger bound only; report max/percentiles/worst components and exact support/gain/range decisions. Investigate every branch mismatch rather than hiding it in RGB tolerance.

tolerance_with_rationale.final_half_store: At most one FP16 ULP only when traced to an independently explained allowed float32 arithmetic difference; exact alpha words and exact forbidden/OFF regions remain mandatory. No extra half quantization before Glass.
tolerance_with_rationale.rationale: Short float32 arithmetic with requested precise/-Gis constraints may still differ by compiler rounding; this is a provisional small arithmetic tolerance, not an image quality threshold or a D3D sampler equivalence claim.
tolerance_with_rationale.native_sampler: Capture actual q/taps/store values for History; ideal NumPy interpolation is not the GPU sampler. Do not widen a geometry/hard-gate mismatch into an accepted numerical error.
tolerance_with_rationale.quality: No aggregate numerical tolerance can accept erased glints/text, phase-dependent flicker, stale true-light response or a worse user game verdict.

timings_and_memory_scope.measurement_method: Use actual GPU timestamp queries around arithmetic, staging/copies, sidecar producer and finalGlass; report same-frame ON-minus-sham and ON-minus-nativeOFF with randomized balanced paired run order. Return sample count, resolution, warmup, clock/power/VSync/frame-limit state, median/percentiles and paired confidence intervals plus sham drift. Keep correlated frame blocks together in intervals.
timings_and_memory_scope.memory_method: Use GetResourceAllocationInfo for actual admitted resources and retain separate family high-water/admission/fallback accounting. Measure residency/full-game provider scope locally if available; logicaltensorbytes and compressed upload sizes are not VRAM estimates.
timings_and_memory_scope.scope_rule: Exclude readback/debug instrumentation from production timing or show it separately. Report native wrapper/mock/AMD/game scopes explicitly. No CPU wall time or oldGlass0.00264ms receipt estimates the new graph.

visual_gate.status: Unexecuted local gate; current candidate remains research-only and rejected for visual shipping on existing CPU evidence.
visual_gate.requested_actual_native_game_ab: Compare preserved user TemporalOFF NZR and existingGlassBlendmode2strength0.5, with matched crop, aspect, exposure, frame timing, camera motion/settle and true light/colour event. CandidateON is an isolated diagnostic only if all missing-sidecar/native gates are met; it is not recommended for installation.
visual_gate.controls: Separate current rawRR, existing NZR-selected, existingBlend0.5, candidatepreGlass+sameBlend0.5, same-mode sham, reduce-correction/blur/freeze nulls by exact actual-native or derived-CPU stage labels.
failure_criteria: Any visible thin-sign/text loss, broadened or erased true bright glint, phase-dependent contrast modulation/flicker or halo across glass/opaque/normal/depth boundaries.
Noise/grain/sparkle-tail or temporal-flicker regression on original fixedBASEmask, actualNZRchangedRGBsubset, edge bands, static texture or newly visible support despite a favorable full-image mean.
True-light/colour response attenuation/delay, movement trails or a win that comes only from stale RGB/history or changed correction strength.
Any protected diffuse/alpha/input/geometry/OFF byte change, settings drift, incorrect source units or source-role alias.
User prefers the existing sharp TemporalOFF result under the same viewing conditions. CPU scores cannot override that verdict.
report_separately: text/line contrast and four block phases
glint peak excess above fixed clean local level
visual_gate.visual_payload_scope: Return a few synchronized same-exposure original/candidate crop frames or a short cropped clip plus timing/tonemap manifest. No full game video requested. Missing albedo/final composite prevents physical final-brightness proof.

surgical_order: First stage1small compute parity. Then2Aonly. Request2Bor2Conly if that missing observable is still needed and attainable; never request fullcaptures/gamehistory as a substitute for a precise diagnostic.
